params.name: Crumbs
params.note: Typed list of PkCrumb: sent as the element's crumbs attribute (a JSON array of { label, href }); the element draws the breadcrumb, home crumb and back link (#801).

existingReason: typed-generics: Crumbs is a typed PkCrumb list sent as JSON; and the title is also a slotted pk-heading in light DOM (FocusOnNavigate cannot reach into a shadow tree, #773)
notes: Hand-written: Title maps to heading and is also drawn as a slotted pk-heading in the title slot (level from Level, tabindex -1, like the JS page shell, #773); Level starts at 1; SuffixContent is the default slot (beside the title). The trail, home crumb and back link are the element's (crumbs, homeHref, backLink).
